changeNote:
v0.5.6

Compatibility / 兼容性
- Updated for Slay the Spire 2 v0.111.0 and its character animator API. / 适配 Slay the Spire 2 v0.111.0 及其角色动画器接口。
- Characters other than the Illusionist can now see and open the Mirror pile after gaining Mirror Image; its icon matches the current character. / 非幻术师角色获得镜像后，现在可以看到并打开镜像牌堆；按钮使用当前角色头像。
- Mirror clones now use their owner's character visuals. Base-game characters and MOD characters that provide a custom visuals path are supported; the Illusionist retains her translucent Spine appearance. / 镜像复制体现在使用其拥有者的角色外观；支持原版角色和提供自定义外观路径的 MOD 角色，幻术师继续使用自身的半透明 Spine 外观。
